# harborpilot_oidc_provider (Resource)

An OpenID Connect single sign-on provider. Register `redirect_uri` with the identity provider. Give the client secret as a reference (`client_secret_ref`) or write-only (`client_secret_wo`, Terraform 1.11+); it is never stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_oidc_provider" "porch" {
  slug                     = "porch"
  display_name             = "Porch"
  issuer                   = "https://porch.example.com"
  client_id                = "harbor-pilot"
  client_secret_wo         = var.oidc_client_secret
  client_secret_wo_version = 1
  scopes                   = ["openid", "profile", "email", "groups"]
  groups_claim             = "porch.groups"
  role_mappings = [
    { group = "platform-admins", role = "admin" },
    { group = "engineers", role = "operator" },
  ]
  provisioning = "jit"
  enabled      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `issuer` (String) Issuer URL (https; http only with `allow_private_network`).
- `provisioning` (String) `preprovisioned` (users must exist) or `jit` (created on first sign-in; needs `allowed_domains` or `role_mappings`).
- `slug` (String) URL slug used in sign-in links.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allow_private_network` (Boolean)
- `allowed_algs` (List of String) Accepted ID token algorithms (default ES256, RS256, EdDSA).
- `allowed_domains` (Set of String)
- `client_secret_ref` (String) `env:NAME` or `file:/path` resolved by the server.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only client secret (Terraform 1.11+). Sent on create and when `client_secret_wo_version` changes.
- `client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Change to send `client_secret_wo` again.
- `default_role` (String)
- `groups_claim` (String) Dotted path of the groups claim, e.g. `groups`.
- `role_mappings` (Attributes List) Group to role mappings, first match wins. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_mappings))
- `scopes` (List of String) Requested scopes (default `openid`, `profile`, `email`). Add `groups` when group claims need it.

### Read-Only

- `client_secret_set` (Boolean) Whether a stored client secret exists.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `redirect_uri` (String)
- `revision` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--role_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role_mappings`

Required:

- `group` (String)
- `role` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harborpilot_oidc_provider.porch <id>
```
